3. Child labor audits: Employers can conduct regular audits of their workplaces to identify any instances of child labor. This can help to prevent child labor from occurring in the first place.
4. Child labor prevention programs: Employers can implement child labor prevention programs to ensure that their workplaces are free from child labor. This can include training programs, workplace safety regulations, and child labor laws.
